delivery_returns:
Orders within Lagos arrive in 1 to 3 working days, and orders to other states in 3 to 5 working days. We call you to arrange a delivery time.

If something doesn't fit, message us within 7 days of delivery to arrange an exchange. Items must be unworn, unwashed and have their tags attached.
